'''Von Qesta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]], who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Qesta owned a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] team and after his main [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] had a run-in with a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], he was forced to look for a new one. He asked the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] racer [[Skall Delos]] to become his new pilot and they became partners.
